c_o_bond_length_acc.conditions: amorphous calcium carbonate, structure model fitted to scattering data (Mg-ACC) and first pair-distribution peak
c_o_bond_length_acc.method: U1: uniform over the sourced span; 2 admitted row(s), 2 independent original(s)
c_o_bond_length_acc.notes: N16 (W7 drawing parameter) for the ACC framing; one fitted model (Mg-ACC) and one pair-distribution peak.

rho_acc.conditions: synthetic Mg-free ACC, dried powder, gas pycnometry, CaCO3.nH2O with n = 1.1 and 0.5
rho_acc.method: not concordant within 2 combined standard uncertainties, so U1; U1: uniform over the sourced span; 2 admitted row(s), 2 independent original(s)
rho_acc.notes: N16 (W7 drawing parameter). Mass density of the ACC phase including its structural water; the two rows are two hydration states of one paper. Mg-ACC (TM-027), biogenic ACC from a scattering fit (TM-028), a force-field model (TM-029) and SAXS of wet colloids (TC-054, TC-055) are comparators. Comparators (not admitted, E2): TG-017, TM-027, TM-028, TM-029, TC-054, TC-055.

v_m_acc.conditions: dried ACC powders by pycnometry, structural water included (CaCO3.1.1H2O and CaCO3.0.5H2O)
v_m_acc.method: U1: uniform over the sourced span; 2 admitted row(s), 2 independent original(s)
v_m_acc.notes: Two hydration states from one paper (Jensen 2018). In situ SAXS density 1.62 g cm^-3 of wet colloidal ACC (TC-054, TC-055) is far lower; that gap is in lit/conflicts.md. The molar volume per CaCO3 includes structural water. Comparators (not admitted, E2): TC-054, TC-055, TG-017.
